summary: Retest of iteration_30 fix (race condition in LoadQuoteModal useEffect). FIX VERIFIED: paperclip file-count badge now renders correctly on TESTE2E1 (count '1') in Saved Quotes; rows with zero files show no badge; badge survives 3 rapid tab toggles between Drafts and Saved Quotes; no console errors; Open actions and DRAFT status pills still render.
critical_code_review_comments: LoadQuoteModal.jsx useEffect (L83-103) now correctly uses an `ignore` flag to discard stale fetches — pattern is the standard React fix and is implemented properly. Cleanup function `return () => { ignore = true; }` resets on every effect re-run.

Note for future cleanup (low priority, not blocking): the underlying double-fetch of /api/drafts after switching to Saved Quotes was not investigated — the ignore flag masks the race but an extra network call still happens. Worth checking if some upstream effect (autosave?) is re-mounting LoadQuoteModal or refetching drafts. Non-blocking since correctness is restored.

Six Open action buttons render and DRAFT status pills are visible. Zero console/page errors captured.
rca of the issue: Original race (iter_30): listDrafts() promise from initial mount resolved AFTER listQuotes() and overwrote items with drafts (which lack file_count), suppressing the badge. Mitigation applied: ignore flag in useEffect cleanup so only the latest promise updates state. Retest confirmed the badge is now rendered and persists under rapid tab switching.
